propositions: Four model-provenance guard tests each invoke _run_request_sites(), re-computing the same immutable AST analysis of src/rebar on every invocation, causing ~46s of redundant work across the four tests.

The cost of a single _run_request_sites() call is dominated by _verdict's parameter-provenance branch re-parsing the entire src/rebar tree once per site with a parameter-sourced config, and _functions re-parsing the tree again, resulting in ~8000+ parses for a single scan.
The analysis is a pure function of committed src/rebar source with no test mutation of the tree and no dependency on autouse fixture state, making caching safe across the test session.

A session-scoped pytest fixture can cache the result of _run_request_sites() once per test process, and a process-local functools.cache on _parsed() can memoize per-file AST parses to eliminate inner repetition.
